The Remarketing Manager will be responsible for defining and implementing vehicle remarketing strategies, with the objective of maximizing residual values, optimizing resale processes, and ensuring profitability across remarketing operations. The role will play a strategic part in managing the used vehicle lifecycle, developing effective sales channels, and monitoring financial and commercial performance, working closely with internal departments and external business partners. Key Responsibilities: Remarketing Strategy & Management: define and implement strategies to maximize vehicle resale values, identifying the most effective sales channels, including dealerships, auctions, digital platforms, and direct sales. Vehicle Lifecycle Optimization: monitor and optimize vehicle holding periods and resale processes, identifying opportunities to reduce operational costs and maximize revenues. Sales Partner Relationship Management: develop and maintain strong relationships with dealerships, auction platforms, and other industry stakeholders, ensuring efficient sales processes and effective management of financial transactions. Risk & Cost Management: monitor residual value trends and vehicle depreciation, identifying corrective actions to mitigate financial risks and optimize remarketing-related costs. Performance Analysis & Reporting: monitor key remarketing KPIs, including sales volumes, profitability, stock turnover, and variances between forecasted and actual residual values, preparing regular reports to support strategic decision-making. Cross-functional Collaboration: work closely with Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams to ensure alignment of commercial strategies and optimization of internal processes. Requirements: Educational Background: bachelor's degree in Economics, Business Administration, Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field, preferably with a business or commercial focus. Professional Experience: minimum 7 years of experience in the automotive industry, with at least 3 years in Remarketing, Used Car Management, Fleet Management, or related roles, preferably within OEMs, leasing companies, long-term rental companies, or specialized remarketing operators Industry Knowledge: solid understanding of the automotive and used vehicle markets, remarketing channels, residual value management, and vehicle lifecycle processes. Negotiation & Relationship Management: excellent negotiation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to develop strategic partnerships, manage commercial relationships, and maximize business profitability. Analytical & Business Skills: strong analytical mindset, results-driven approach, and ability to interpret financial and commercial data, monitor KPIs, and identify opportunities for cost optimization and performance improvement. Digital Skills: excellent proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, with familiarity with reporting and data analysis tools. Language Skills: excellent command of English, both written and spoken, to effectively communicate with international teams and stakeholders. Ownership & Proactivity: ability to work independently, manage priorities, make decisions, and propose innovative solutions, with a proactive, pragmatic, and goal-oriented mindset. What We Offer Stability & Recognition: permanent employment contract under the Italian Metalworking Industry Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria), with a competitive compensation package (Salary Range: €75,000–€85,000 gross annually + benefits). Global Mindset: opportunity to join a rapidly expanding multinational company, working in an international environment with direct interaction with European and Asian headquarters and teams. Grow with Us: opportunities for professional growth, skills development, and the chance to actively contribute to the evolution of the business. Innovation & Future Mobility: opportunity to play an active role in the transformation of the automotive industry and the future of sustainable mobility. Make an Impact: a dynamic environment where ideas, personal initiative, and an entrepreneurial mindset can make a real difference. People & Collaboration: a multicultural and collaborative workplace that encourages knowledge sharing, teamwork, and the achievement of common goals. Ownership & Empowerment: autonomy, responsibility, and the freedom to bring forward innovative ideas and solutions, making a tangible contribution to the company's performance and growth. Segnala offerta di lavoro Founded in 1913 in Italy, the Prada Group was built on a tradition of excellence and with a vision of innovation. The Group, a world leader in the luxury sector, operates in more than 45 countries with the PRADA, Miu Miu, Versace, Church's, Car Shoe and Luna Rossa brands, and has employees of over 100 nationalities. Job Purpose We seek a high performing business development professional to join a dynamic team to develop Prada Fine Jewelry business in one of our fastest growing regions. Your primary responsibilities will be to oversee and execute fine and high jewelry sales, build and maintain strong client relationships, and develop new business opportunities. Your objective will not only be to maximize sales performance but also to strategically grow our high-end products client portfolio, with a strong focus on recruiting new clientele. Responsibilities Fine and High Jewelry Sales Execution: Partner with the senior business development manager to drive sales in Fine & High Jewelry category, ensuring an exceptional luxury experience tailored to each client. Maintain and exceed individual and regional sales targets, delivering outstanding customer service in line with the brand's standards. Consolidate sales results by market and store, monitor progress against targets and highlight gaps, trends and opportunities for review with the Senior Manager. Prepare reports, presentations and meeting materials; maintain action plans with clear owners and deadlines and follow up with local teams. Coordinate event calendars, product selections, logistics, appointment schedules and operational checklists in collaboration with the relevant teams. Lead by example, coaching and inspiring the store team in fine & high jewelry sales techniques and best practices. Prepare and update training presentations, product information and operational guidelines under the Senior Manager's direction; organize training sessions and track participation. Client Development & Acquisition Identify and recruit high-potential clients, cultivating relationships through exclusive events, private appointments, and personalized outreach. Develop and execute strategies to enhance client retention, ensuring a high level of engagement and loyalty. Maintain an updated and segmented client database, leveraging CRM tools for targeted outreach and clienteling activities. Stay ahead of industry trends and competitor activities to attract ultra-high-net-worth individuals (UHNWI) and affluent clients. Work closely with Client Experience and Retail Events teams in Head Office to create bespoke experiences tailored to high-end clientele. Operational Excellence Consolidate product requests and check stock availability with HQ Merchandising; prepare allocation and rebalancing proposals for approval. Coordinate approved product transfers with Customer Service, Operations and stores, tracking shipments, receipt and returns. Maintain accurate product lists, catalogues and store information; coordinate VM and display requests and follow up on implementation. Maintain made-to-order trackers covering specifications, approvals, deposits, production updates, expected deliveries and outstanding actions, using information confirmed by the responsible teams. Collect complete documentation for client requests, repairs and after-sales cases; coordinate updates with Customer Service and stores and flag delays or unresolved issues. Provide feedback to senior management regarding client preferences, market trends, and opportunities for growth. Knowledge And Skills Minimum 5+ years of experience in luxury retail, preferably in high-end sales categories such as fine jewelry, exotics, or bespoke products. Strong network and ability to network, acquire, and develop new clients through strategic outreach and events. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail and reliable follow-through across several markets and simultaneous priorities. Strong data analysis skills and proficiency in Excel (including lookups, pivot tables and data consolidation); confident use of PowerPoint and familiarity with CRM and order management. Fluency in Italian and English. Clear, professional communication and the ability to build effective relationships with store teams, HQ functions and external partners across cultures and levels of seniority. Segnala offerta di lavoro Direct Sales · Sales Process Development 📍 Milan, Italy 💼 Permanent, Full Time 💰 €35,000–€38,000 gross annual salary, based on experience, plus sales commissions The opportunity Do you have around 3–5 years of hands-on B2B sales experience and the ambition to take your next career step in a growing business where your contribution makes a visible difference? ThinkFree is looking for an ambitious, hands-on Sales & Process Development Manager to win new customers, build repeatable sales processes and help scale our commercial network. You will combine direct sales responsibility with the opportunity to shape how we grow, working closely with the Founders and seeing your ideas turn into action. Your initial focus will be our digital ecosystem for certified skills and verified professional profiles, serving schools, training organizations, institutions and enterprise partners. You will work directly with the Founders and closely with our sales network, commercial partners, Marketing, Product and Customer Success teams. Your first priority is to generate sales. Alongside your individual sales targets, you will develop the processes, tools and working methods needed to scale our sales network. We are looking for someone who can close a deal, understand what made it work and turn that experience into a method others can use. What you will do 1. Generate opportunities and close sales Plan the territorial expansion of the sales network, defining priority areas, coverage needs and where to deploy salespeople and commercial partners. Build and manage your pipeline through outbound prospecting, inbound leads, referrals and partner relationships. Maintain a high, consistent level of targeted outreach, calls, meetings and follow-ups. Understand customer needs and translate them into clear commercial proposals. Coordinate customer handovers and identify further commercial opportunities with Customer Success. 2. Develop sales processes Work with the Founders and sales network to standardize pipeline stages, qualification criteria and follow-up practices. Define clear responsibilities, milestones and next actions throughout the sales cycle. Improve workflows for prospecting, proposals, negotiation and commercial handover. Monitor pipeline progression, conversion rates and sales cycles to identify delays and inefficiencies. Collaborate with the colleague responsible for CRM to define commercial requirements for workflows, automation and reporting. 3. Make the sales method transferable Create reusable outreach scripts, email sequences, proposal templates and sales materials. Turn customer objections and successful responses into practical sales guidance. Support the onboarding of new salespeople and commercial partners through shared tools, clear processes and practical guidance. What we are looking for An ambitious, hands-on commercial professional who combines the drive to sell with the discipline to build a better way of working. You should bring: Approximately 2–4 years of experience in B2B Sales , with evidence of personally closed deals. Experience managing opportunities from first contact through negotiation and signature. Willingness to prospect actively and sustain a high level of commercial activity. Strong planning, prioritization and follow-up skills. Hands-on CRM experience; HubSpot is preferred . Confidence using sales data, reports and dashboards. Evidence of improving a commercial process, CRM workflow or sales tool. Initiative, resilience and ownership of results. Strong written and spoken Italian, plus working proficiency in English. Availability for frequent customer visits across Italy and occasional travel abroad. Experience in SaaS, education, HR Tech, training or institutional sales is an advantage. How success will be measured New customers, signed contracts and revenue generated. Qualified pipeline, conversion rates and sales cycle length. Reliable CRM data, follow-up and forecasts. Adoption of shared sales workflows and tools across the commercial network. Process improvements that save time and support commercial results. What you will gain A fixed salary plus commissions linked to sales performance. Direct collaboration with the Founders and an active role in developing the sales network. Ownership of your sales pipeline and concrete process improvement projects. The opportunity to shape sales processes, commercial tools and working methods. A path toward broader responsibility as the business and commercial organization grow. How to apply Apply directly via LinkedIn or send your CV to a.reboa@thinkfreeholding.com Include concrete examples of: What you have sold, to whom and with what results. How you built and managed your pipeline. A commercial process, CRM workflow or sales tool you improved, and the result it produced. What you have sold, built and improved matters more to us than your formal job title. Together, we're shaping the future of construction. Ready to make your impact? Join us as Sales Manager TIR (Technical Insulation Residential) in Italy. As Sales Manager TIR, you will drive the commercial development and execution of our Technical Insulation Residential (TIR) business across Italy. This is a field-focused sales role for a commercially driven professional who enjoys building customer relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and delivering sustainable growth. Working closely with distributors, contractors, installers, and key customers, you will play a key role in expanding our market presence and strengthening our position as a trusted partner in the insulation market. A key part of the role is market education through customer visits, product demonstrations, and training activities for distributors, installers, and other market stakeholders.We are looking for a hands-on sales professional rather than a highly technical or executive-level profile. What you'll do Drive sales growth by executing commercial plans and achieving revenue, margin, and profitability targets across Italy. Spend significant time in the field developing relationships with customers, distributors, installers, and key market stakeholders. Identify and secure new business opportunities while growing and maintaining existing customer relationships. Manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and opportunity development through negotiation and deal closure. Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline through effective CRM management, forecasting, and structured follow-up. Analyse market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities to identify growth opportunities and commercial priorities. Lead commercial discussions and negotiations while ensuring long-term customer satisfaction and profitable business development. Act as the voice of the customer, translating market insights into actionable recommendations and value propositions. Represent Etex Building Performance at customer meetings, trade fairs, industry events, and commercial presentations. Support product and solution presentations as well as customer and distributor training activities when required. Collaborate closely with Technical Support, Product Management, Customer Service, Supply Chain, Marketing, and Finance teams to deliver an excellent customer experience. What you'll bring 3-5 years of successful external B2B sales experience. Proven track record of delivering profitable sales growth and developing new business opportunities. Strong commercial mindset with excellent relationship-building, negotiation, and customer management skills. Experience within building materials, construction, insulation, industrial products, or related sectors is highly valued. A proactive, hands-on approach and willingness to spend significant time in the field with customers. Experience in key account management, customer development, and territory management. Solid understanding of pipeline management, forecasting, pricing, and margin management. Experience working with CRM systems, ideally Salesforce. Strong analytical and organisational skills with the ability to translate market insights into business opportunities. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint. A degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent professional experience and a strong commercial track record will also be considered. Fluent Italian and English, both written and spoken. Willingness to travel frequently across Italy and internationally. Why join us? Etex's strong purpose 'Building Better Together' is shaping a new future for the construction industry and helping to build a better future for all. Our culture: we connect & care about those around us. We nurture teamwork, communities, partnerships, and new ways of working, placing the highest importance on the safety and working environment of our people. Our Road to Sustainability 2030 is our plan to help build a better, sustainable future. We work towards this vision by caring about our social and environmental impacts and developing innovative solutions. We have a strong conviction that diversity of thinking helps us to deliver strong and sustainable performance. It is also essential for us that everyone feels part of the team. In this spirit, we are committed to equal opportunities and zero tolerance towards discrimination. Enjoy a high level of autonomy, exposure to international markets, and opportunities for professional growth within a global organization committed to innovation and sustainability. Location: Italy (Remote) Travel: Frequent national and international travel required.
